reference: Actual original public custom constructors, original CPU graph planner and callback dispatch, captured before Rust custom-operation implementation. Callback arithmetic is independent byte/integer input code, not supplied by the Rust product.
qualifications: Out-of-place custom operations only. All output bytes are written; no uninitialized read or shared-input writes.
All invocation indices, effective task counts, source pointer order and userdata are asserted. Each effective task runs on a distinct actual native thread.
Padded immutable sources and F32/F16/I32/Q4_0 destination byte layouts are exercised without invoking numeric conversion.
Cases cover generic zero through nine input tensors. Empty outputs skip all callbacks in the original graph executor (v1 assertion failure retained).
Source buffers are initialized leaves with public ne/nb descriptor fields within their allocated storage.
